name: Matsu of Naha
bio: Matsu brings copper aboard the White Tern. She accepts a hard bargain, but not a present whose value changes once another ship has been assessed.
notes: fact: Ryukyuan junks sailed to Melaka and carried Japanese copper for trade; presents were assessed instead of the usual western duty (docs/research/commodities.md, Copper; docs/research/ships-weights-currency.md, Chinese and Ryukyuan Junks)

gameplay: The White Tern is a Ryukyuan junk carrying copper ingots and silk. Matsu wants pepper for her outward cargo and compares her assessment with other eastern captains' (docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §§05, 08)

gameplay: Explain an assessment consistently and she puts her copper up for a shared purchase by Jalal and Sri Rangan. Change it to coax one ship into staying and she asks to sail with Lin Wen instead (docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §§08–10)
